$comment: Declarative field-ordering rules for tools/lint_artifacts.py check_field_order. The canonical narrative lives in models/common-fields.md §3. Ordered groups follow the object-category convention surfaced in the spec: identity/schema/scope, subject/issuer, body, validity, issuance, and audit. All precedence, immediate-follow, ordered-group, and role-placement rules are enforced as lint errors.

ordered_groups.$comment: Within each named category group, when two member fields are both present on the same object they MUST appear in the listed order. Presence-conditional: missing members never trigger.

role_after_subject.$comment: In subject/issuer grouped objects, a `role` discriminator MUST follow the principal/actor identity field it qualifies rather than precede it.

cluster_precedence.$comment: The validity cluster (not_before/issued_at/effective_at/expires_at) MUST precede the creation/audit cluster (created_by/created_at) when both appear on the same object. models/common-fields.md §3.2.
